crossRefs.note: Abram fell on his face. God talked with him, saying,
Yahweh went his way, as soon as he had finished communing with Abraham, and Abraham returned to his place.
God appeared to Jacob again, when he came from Paddan Aram, and blessed him.
Yahweh said to Moses, “This is what you shall tell the children of Israel: ‘You yourselves have seen that I have talked…
He said, “Now hear my words. If there is a prophet among you, I, Yahweh, will make myself known to him in a vision. I…
Yahweh spoke with you face to face on the mountain out of the middle of the fire,
Then Yahweh’s angel stretched out the end of the staff that was in his hand, and touched the meat and the unleavened…
For when the flame went up toward the sky from off the altar, Yahweh’s angel ascended in the flame of the altar. Manoah…
No one has seen God at any time. The one and only Son, who is in the bosom of the Father, has declared him.
I and the Father are one.”

people.name: Abraham
people.line: Patriarch, chosen by God to father His people

translations.web: When he finished talking with him, God went up from Abraham.
translations.bsb: When He had finished speaking with Abraham, God went up from him.
translations.kjv: And he left off talking with him, and God went up from Abraham.
translations.asv: And he left off talking with him, and God went up from Abraham.
